m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Don't eat me! Please don't eat me! I really-really don't want to be eaten! Help!
Oh my stars and garters! That was close.
It's lucky you showed up before that horrible bug ate me! I knew this place was dangerous the moment we arrived.
I thought I'd be safe by skipping the Savannah trip and staying in Baobab. I never knew they had such giant bugs here!
The other students? No, I haven't seen anybody since they left. I've been hiding... er, studying... here.
A map? Sure, I have a map of the Savannah. You can have it. I'm getting out of this place!
<ITALICS>Simone Brightlance hands you the map. You should take it back to Councilor Kakenya Brokenfang. </ITALICS>
Yes, I gave permission for the students to travel to the Savannah, but now they are lost and probably dead.
The Savannah is too dangerous a place for outsiders. Death runs on quick legs, and the weak fall beneath tooth and spear.
You would get lost and die from hunger or thirst if I let you go. You don't even have a map.
Where would you get a map? Harummm. You are persistent, aren't you? There is probably a map in the student dormitory.
Very well, then. If you can find a map in the dormitory, I will give you my permission to enter the Savannah.
I won't allow you to go into the Savannah without a map. Check the student dormitory for a map.
